# Phase Two — Gevurah Architecture and Exact File Families

Chesed imagines every possible chamber; Gevurah guards the borders. The Awtsmoos is beyond both, while Awtsmoos.com needs each implementation wave to preserve what already works.

## Immediate Home closure

Read before any Home rewrite:
- `style/tf.css`
- every transitive import from `style/tf.css`
- current `geelooy/index.html`
- current `geelooy/style/home-simple/base.css`
- current `geelooy/style/home-simple/components.css`

Probable Home touch:
- `geelooy/index.html` only if `/style/tf.css` is proven required and compatible.
- No shared stylesheet is rewritten merely because Home imports it; shared component callers must be mapped first.

## Docs discovery wave

Read:
- `geelooy/docs/index.html`
- Docs CSS manifests and active imports.
- Docs boot modules and DOM selector registries.
- Docs README/architecture/tests if present.

Then classify:
- global selectors
- file-size violations
- arbitrary z-index values
- mobile overflow
- dense controls that should retract
- incomplete focus/active/disabled states
- duplicated JS state or transport logic

## Drive discovery wave

Read:
- `geelooy/drive/index.html`
- Drive CSS manifests/active imports.
- Drive shell/layout JS and selector contracts.
- Tests/docs.

Then classify:
- pane ownership
- scroll ownership
- mobile retraction
- drag/drop overlays
- context menus
- dialogs
- keyboard focus
- selection state
- arbitrary layers
- file-size and modularity debt

## Shared safety rules

- Never edit a shared stylesheet until its importers are mapped.
- Never hide layout failures with blanket `overflow: hidden`.
- Never replace arbitrary z-index numbers without understanding intended ordering.
- Never rename IDs/data attributes until JS call sites are traced.
- Never compress a file to satisfy the ceiling; split responsibility.
- Never claim browser proof when the adapter did not return evidence.

## NEXT_ACTION

Resolve Home's shared component dependency, run the final Home audit, then start Docs archaeology.
